questions.question: When was the UN Universal Declaration of Human Rights adopted?
questions.explanation: The Universal Declaration of Human Rights was adopted by the United Nations in 1948 and contains 30 articles.

questions.question: What does Article 1 of the Universal Declaration state?
options: All human beings are born free and equal in dignity and rights
Everyone must serve in the military
questions.explanation: Article 1 states that all human beings are born free and equal in dignity and rights.

questions.question: Who do human rights apply to?
options: All people, everywhere, at all times
questions.explanation: Human rights are universal: they apply to all people, everywhere, at all times, without distinction of any kind.

questions.question: What was the Civil Rights Movement in the USA?
options: A movement in the 1950s-60s fighting racial segregation and discrimination
A war between the northern and southern states
questions.explanation: The Civil Rights Movement, led by figures like Martin Luther King Jr., fought against racial segregation and for equal rights in the 1950s and 60s.

questions.question: Which right is protected by Article 19 of the Universal Declaration?
options: The right to drive a car
The right to never pay taxes
questions.explanation: Article 19 protects freedom of opinion and expression. Article 26 covers the right to education and Article 18 freedom of thought and religion.
